units: Y. M. Kat. I, 80ᵈ bot.—מחט של מ׳ a pin used in weaving or embroidery to draw the thread tight, spool.

<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 13:5">Ib.</cite> <he>התקינה למ׳</he> (ed. Dehr. <he>למיתא</he>, v. <cite ref="M01323"><he>מֵיתָא</he></cite> II a. <cite ref="M01333"><he>מֵיתָנָא</he></cite>). Ib. 8; <cite ref="Yevamot 43a:3">Yeb. 43ᵃ</cite> <he>לנר או למ׳</he> (Kel. ed. Dehr. <he>למיתא</he>) made for snuffing the light (v. <cite ref="M00849"><he>מָחַט</he></cite>) or as a spool.
